messages:
tanya: Quick flag - our sample-app onboarding hit another SDK parity quirk with tool/function-call + json_mode + schema. Node returns parsed dict for tool result, Python sometimes returns a JSON string, causing our structured-output helpers to blow up on retries.

sam: ouch. can you share repro?

tanya: minimal: call Responses API with json_mode=true, tool_call with schema, streaming disabled. Node: part.tool_call.result -> {id:1, name:'A'}; Py: part.tool_call.result -> '{"id":1,"name":"A"}' (string). Retry wrapper serializes again.

natalie: thanks. sounds similar to earlier reports but maybe nested mapping missed in py SDK refactor. Do we have the raw raw_text for the part?\

tanya: we do, attached in ticket. quick snippet: JS:
```js
const r = await c.responses.create({input:p, json_mode:true, tool_call:{name:'get', schema:user}});
// r.output[0].tool_call.result => {id:1}
```

Python:
```py
r = client.responses.create(input=p, json_mode=True, tool_call={"name":"get","schema":user})
# r.output[0].tool_call.result => '{"id":1}'
```

sam: simple stopgap in sample-app: normalize if isinstance(str) try json.loads. But for long term, py SDK should parse nested tool results when json_mode or when content looks like JSON string.

natalie: I'll pick up the py SDK patch. Plan: add nested deserialization logic behind a compatibility flag parse_nested_toolcall=True, write unit tests asserting parity with node fixture, then flip default after audit. Will also add test for retry wrapper to prevent double-encoding.

tanya: filed DEVEX-974 with logs and small repro. added samplekit integration test stub tests/integration/test_toolcall_nested_parity.py.

sam: CI?

ci-bot: pipeline samplekit/parity-974 started :hammer_and_wrench:

natalie: ETA for PR is tomorrow morning PST. I'll include changelog note and a short onboarding doc entry pointing to the issue.

tanya: adding short doc note now: "If you see string tool results in Python SDK, upgrade to snapshot or open DEVEX-974." :memo:

ci-bot: pipeline samplekit/parity-974 passed :white_check_mark:
